params.name: ids
params.description: A comma separated list of ids specifying the entities to delete. These ids must be official ids.

params.name: to_delete
params.description: Set the to_delete sysan as true or false. If none, then don't try to set the sysan, and instead delete the node.

items.docs: Delete existing entities. Using the :http:method:`delete` on a project's endpoint will *completely delete* an entity. The Gen3 commons does not allow deletions or creations that would leave nodes without parents, i.e. nodes that do not have an entity from which they were derived. To prevent catastrophic mistakes, the current philosophy is to disallow automatic cascading of deletes.
